description: This Kotlin source file defines a test implementation of the UserDataRepository interface, providing in-memory management of user data for testing purposes, including methods to modify user preferences and a sample initial user data object.

classes.name: TestUserDataRepository
classes.description: A test implementation of UserDataRepository that manages user data in-memory using a MutableSharedFlow, allowing simulation of user data changes for testing purposes.

methods.name: setFollowedTopicIds
methods.description: Sets the list of followed topic IDs in the user data.

methods.name: setTopicIdFollowed
methods.description: Updates the follow status of a specific topic ID.

methods.name: setNewsResourceBookmarked
methods.description: Marks a news resource as bookmarked or unbookmarked.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Marks a news resource as viewed or not viewed.

methods.name: setShouldHideOnboarding
methods.description: Sets whether onboarding should be hidden.

methods.name: setUserData
methods.description: Test-only method to set user data directly.
